headline: Backend-First Full Stack Engineer | Web Systems & Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Backend-first full stack engineer with 5+ years building and stabilizing web systems across healthcare, finance, B2B, retail, and legal workflows. Combines .NET/SQL and Python/FastAPI depth with Angular/Vue integration, Terraform, CI/CD, and AWS/Google Cloud delivery. Strongest at tracing problems across user workflows, application logic, databases, and infrastructure—cutting critical administration workflows from 5–8 minutes to 5 seconds and enabling local verification for a 40–50 API financial platform despite restricted client access.

experience.title: Software Engineer — Backend & Cloud Infrastructure (Contract)
bullets: Restructured a prototype FastAPI backend around domain, API, persistence, and provider boundaries; added SQLAlchemy repositories, Alembic migrations, Shopify onboarding, runtime validation, and quality gates.

Refactored the Form 13.1 data-to-document flow, mapping DOCX/YAML metadata to FormKit fields and user input back to indexed DOCX fields; added dynamic rows, multiline handling, and behavior-focused tests for variable-length financial and property records.

Rebuilt the Terraform deployment path from an AWS EC2/NGINX design to Google Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, Workload Identity Federation, and Cloud Monitoring, with separated development and production resources.

experience.title: Web Development Engineer
bullets: During annual conference registration, cut accounting, event, and membership administration workflows from 5–8 minutes to 5 seconds, fastest 0.4 seconds, on a Vue.js and ASP.NET MVC healthcare platform serving about 3,000 members by replacing multi-table AutoMapper/LINQ paths with SQL Server procedures, views, and functions.

Designed 20–30 REST APIs for coupon, merchant, and membership workflows and aligned NSwag-documented contracts with an Angular 12 frontend, using JWT authentication, transaction-protected data changes, and Docker-based SQL Server development.
Resolved reports of missing high-value orders on an iPad/Safari POS by tracing the issue to status-based filtering rather than data loss, correcting the query logic, and reducing repeat incidents.

Built the company's first AWS development and test environment for a 40–50 API financial platform, enabling development and verification without depending on restricted client access before delivering 4–5 APIs and completing on-site acceptance.

Mitigated a week-long traffic and scraper incident on a top-three Taiwan used-car marketplace with 50–70k monthly visits by using Azure Monitor to identify App Service saturation and configuring autoscaling during service recovery.

experience.title: ERP Applications Engineer
bullets: Resolved cross-layer defects across AngularJS screens, ASP.NET MVC logic, and Oracle, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL data flows for a nationwide B2B platform covering product search, inventory, quotation, ordering, and member workflows.

Built an Angular 8 and ASP.NET MVC 5 PoC with NG-ZORRO as a modernization reference for the legacy AngularJS platform, then documented and shared the Angular approach with the ERP engineering department.

skills.items: Python, FastAPI, C#, .NET, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle Database, SQLAlchemy, FormKit, DOCX XML
Angular, AngularJS, Vue.js, NG-ZORRO, REST APIs, OpenAPI / NSwag
AWS, Google Cloud, Cloud Run, Azure App Service, Azure Monitor, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker
